name: Twin Harbours
idea: Two stone harbours, blue on the left and red on the right, with a short bounce lane between them.
hint: Blue first. The red well sits under the right harbour's roof; the blue well under the left one is reusable.

name: Trapdoor Circuit
idea: A stone shelf splits the field, with a gap at the far left and a grey trapdoor on the right. The red well sits on the shelf.
hint: Both floors need both colours. The trapdoor gives quick rebounds while it lasts; break it and the right side becomes a short way up.

name: Return Ticket
idea: A red-capped vault keeps blue inside, and a red plug sits on the blue well. Turn red to open both, then return to blue.
hint: Blue → red → blue. Break the red plug over the blue well before you need it again. R restarts instantly.
